name: What details should I determine before planning an in-law suite?
description: Clarify mobility needs, decide between a full kitchen or kitchenette, locate your property boundaries and utility lines, and establish a clear target budget.

mainEntity.name: What details should I determine before planning an in-law suite?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before scheduling an estimate, you should clearly define how the space will be used both now and in the future. Determine whether the occupant needs single-story access, wider doorways, or a curbless walk-in shower to accommodate reduced mobility. Decide whether a full kitchen with a stove is necessary or if a compact kitchenette with a sink, microwave, and small refrigerator is sufficient. You should also gather your property survey to check boundary lines, identify where existing plumbing and electrical panels sit, and clarify your overall budget range so the contractor can propose realistic floor plans.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clarify mobility needs, decide between a full kitchen or kitchenette, locate your property boundaries and utility lines, and establish a clear target budget.
